newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's PHIBOR ease in tandem with spot rates.
newsitem.headline: Manila's PHIBOR ease in tandem with spot rates.

text.p: The Philippine interbank offered rates (PHIBOR) slipped in all maturities with the short-term rates falling more than two percentage points, traders said.
"Everybody's adjusting their rates after the central bank cut its overnight rates last week," one trader said, adding further cuts were expected in the coming days.
PHIBOR rose sharply in recent weeks after the benchmark overnight borrowing rate shot up to as high as 32 percent. PHIBOR usually track the movement in the corresponding spot rates.
The decline in longer end of the curve was slower as banks waited for the results of Monday's Treasury bills auction.
